name: find_videos
description: Find videos the user has selected, optionally filtering by minimum file size in megabytes and sorting largest first.

name: suggest_compression
description: Estimate suitable compression settings for a selected video. This only makes a recommendation; no file is changed.

name: compress_selected_video
description: Ask to compress one video that the user previously selected. This must display a confirmation and output preview before execution; never delete the original.
